---
title: "Unit 05 · Initial-value ODE problems and molecular dynamics"
toc: false
---

Unit 5 develops the numerical solution of ordinary differential equations, the step that turns Newton's second law into a trajectory of atoms in time. The bridging lecture [L22](L22/index.qmd) precedes this unit: it follows the pitch-drop experiment from the funnel to the atoms and links each level to a simulation method and its numerical core. [L23](L23/index.qmd) introduces initial-value problems through one vibrating atom, from its analytical trajectory to Euler, Runge–Kutta, and SciPy integration.

- [L23 · Solving initial-value problems](L23/index.qmd)
- [L25 · Molecular dynamics (2): control and analysis](L25/index.qmd) — time steps, periodic boundaries, ensembles, structure, and diffusion.
